integrity: The theorem follows from the classical nine-block injective D4 classification and Krull--Schmidt. The bundled finite-field orbit computation is an independent replay of low dimensions, not a proof of the general field-independent statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact orbit series is a short derived invariant of the classical three-subspace classification. An equivalent formula may exist in older or unindexed representation-theory literature; no claim is made for four subspaces or for a new infinite-dimensional classification.
title: Field-independent orbit series on the tame side of the three-subspace boundary
